dinners.name: Pork medallions with mushroom cream & green beans

ingredients.item: Pork loin, raw - Jake 280 g, Laine 85 g
Heavy cream - Jake 55 g, Laine 25 g
Sour cream - Jake 25 g, Laine 12 g
Green beans - Jake 100 g, Laine 40 g
Low-sodium beef broth - Jake 40 g, Laine 20 g
Minced garlic - Jake 3 g, Laine 1.5 g

steps: Slice pork into thick medallions; season with salt and pepper. Sear in half the butter until 145 F. Rest at least 3 min.
Brown mushrooms in the pan. Add garlic, broth and cream; simmer until spoon-coating. Turn off heat before stirring in sour cream.
Cook green beans in the remaining butter. Divide the pork, vegetables and sauce using the listed portions.
dinners.note: Laine's supper is half of a comparable former Laine serving. Use the separately listed portions.

dinners.name: Bacon-cheddar turkey mini meatloaves & cauliflower mash

ingredients.item: Ground turkey 93/7, raw - Jake 280 g, Laine 85 g (raw weight)
Bacon, cooked - Jake 16 g, Laine 6 g
Block cheddar - Jake 30 g, Laine 12 g
Almond flour - Jake 8 g, Laine 3 g
Heavy cream - Jake 35 g, Laine 18 g
Dijon mustard - Jake 5 g, Laine 2.5 g

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Mix turkey, almond flour, Dijon and half the cheddar; shape separate mini loaves, with Laine's smaller. Top with bacon and remaining cheddar.
Bake until the center reaches 165 F, about 20-25 min. Use the thermometer rather than size alone.
Steam cauliflower until tender, drain very well, then blend with butter and cream. Serve the measured mash beside each loaf.
dinners.note: Laine's supper is half of a comparable former Laine serving. Use the separately listed portions.

dinners.name: Coriander-lime chicken thighs, browned cabbage & cilantro cream

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs, raw - Jake 300 g, Laine 90 g (raw weight)
Green cabbage - Jake 130 g, Laine 65 g
Sour cream - Jake 45 g, Laine 22 g
Olive oil - Jake 8 g, Laine 4 g
Lime juice - Jake 10 g, Laine 5 g
Minced garlic - Jake 3 g, Laine 1.5 g
Fresh cilantro - Jake 5 g, Laine 2 g

ingredients.nutritionNote: Small seasoning quantities are excluded from approximate macros.

steps: Season thighs with ground coriander, cumin, salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil and finish covered until at least 165 F.
Brown sliced cabbage in butter over medium-high heat; add garlic for the last 30 seconds.
Mix sour cream with lime and chopped cilantro. Spoon over the chicken. Add cayenne or hot sauce to Jake's plate only.
dinners.note: Laine's supper is half of a comparable former Laine serving. Use the separately listed portions.

dinners.name: Sausage-cabbage skillet with thyme mustard cream

ingredients.item: Mild bulk pork sausage, raw - Jake 220 g, Laine 75 g (raw weight)
Green cabbage - Jake 150 g, Laine 65 g
Heavy cream - Jake 55 g, Laine 25 g
Dijon mustard - Jake 8 g, Laine 4 g
Grated Parmesan - Jake 15 g, Laine 7.5 g
Low-sodium beef broth - Jake 35 g, Laine 20 g

ingredients.nutritionNote: Small seasoning quantities are excluded from approximate macros.

steps: Brown mild bulk sausage thoroughly to 160 F. Lift out and discard excess rendered fat.
Add butter and sliced cabbage; cook until browned and just tender. Add thyme and broth, then cream and Dijon.
Reduce until thick enough to coat the cabbage. Return sausage, melt in Parmesan and portion onto plates.
dinners.note: Laine's supper is half of a comparable former Laine serving. Use the separately listed portions.

dinners.name: Crisp salmon with lime brown butter & roasted asparagus

ingredients.item: Salmon, raw - Jake 230 g, Laine 80 g (raw weight)
Olive oil - Jake 7 g, Laine 3 g
Lime juice - Jake 10 g, Laine 5 g
Minced garlic - Jake 3 g, Laine 1.5 g

steps: Heat oven to 425 F. Toss asparagus with olive oil and salt; roast until crisp-tender, about 10-12 min.
Sear dry salmon skin-side down, then finish gently to 145 F. Keep Laine's smaller portion separate.
Brown butter in a small pan, remove from heat, then stir in garlic and lime. Spoon over the fish; serve peach crumble after supper.
dinners.note: Laine's supper is half of a comparable former Laine serving. Use the separately listed portions.

desserts.name: Peach-pecan crumble with cold cream

ingredients.item: Unsweetened peach slices - Jake 50 g, Laine 50 g
Almond flour - Jake 12 g, Laine 12 g
Heavy cream - Jake 18 g, Laine 18 g
Cinnamon - 1/4 tsp; monk fruit/erythritol blend - 1-2 tsp
ingredients.nutritionNote: Small seasoning quantities are excluded from approximate macros.

steps: Heat oven to 350 F. Divide 100 g chopped unsweetened peaches and 1/4 tsp cinnamon between two 8 oz ramekins.
Rub the 16 g butter into the 24 g almond flour, 16 g pecans and 1-2 tsp cup-for-cup monk fruit/erythritol blend. Divide over the fruit.
Bake 20-25 min until golden and bubbling. Rest 10 min. Serve each ramekin with 18 g cold cream.
desserts.note: 50 g peach per person; the ramekins will be partly filled. Use unsweetened fruit and a sweetener without sugar or dextrose.

dinners.name: Coffee-rubbed steak, garlic-butter mushrooms & Parmesan mash

ingredients.item: Steak, raw - Jake 280 g, Laine 85 g (raw weight)
Heavy cream - Jake 40 g, Laine 20 g
Grated Parmesan - Jake 15 g, Laine 7.5 g
Minced garlic - Jake 3 g, Laine 1.5 g
Smoked paprika and finely ground coffee - 1/2 tsp each
ingredients.nutritionNote: Small seasoning quantities are excluded from approximate macros.

steps: Season steak with finely ground coffee, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Sear to 145 F and rest at least 3 min.
Brown mushrooms in half the butter. Add garlic at the end.
Steam and drain cauliflower; blend with remaining butter, cream and Parmesan. Slice steak and serve with the measured mushrooms and mash.
dinners.note: Laine's supper is half of a comparable former Laine serving. Use the separately listed portions.

dinners.name: Thyme-roasted chicken thighs, pan gravy & golden zucchini

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs, raw - Jake 300 g, Laine 90 g (raw weight)
Heavy cream - Jake 45 g, Laine 22 g
Low-sodium beef broth - Jake 50 g, Laine 25 g
Dijon mustard - Jake 5 g, Laine 2.5 g
Olive oil - Jake 5 g, Laine 2.5 g

ingredients.nutritionNote: Small seasoning quantities are excluded from approximate macros.

steps: Season chicken with thyme, salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil; finish in a 400 F oven to at least 165 F.
Brown zucchini coins in half the butter without crowding.
Deglaze the chicken pan with broth. Add cream and Dijon; reduce until thick, then whisk in remaining butter. Spoon over the chicken.
dinners.note: Laine's supper is half of a comparable former Laine serving. Use the separately listed portions.

prepPlan: Sunday Nov 29: Make Jake's three lunch bowls and Laine's three cold lunch choices. Keep nuts and dressings separate.

Of 615 g cooked turkey: refrigerate 165 g for Mon-Wed. Freeze 160 g for Thursday soup, 50 g for Saturday and 240 g for Sunday. Freeze 330 g raw pork for Saturday lunch. Keep chilled food at 40 F or below and use within 3-4 days.
Wednesday: Thaw the 160 g soup turkey in the refrigerator during the day. In the evening, make the road egg bites and chowder. Chill promptly in shallow containers.

Thursday morning: Reheat soup to 165 F. Preheat food thermoses with boiling water for a few minutes; empty and immediately fill with hot soup. Seal until lunch; soup must stay at 140 F or above. Put egg bites and Laine's remaining Second Breakfast and Afternoon Tea choices in a cooler with two ice packs at 40 F or below.

Thursday night: Thaw Friday salmon in the refrigerator. Friday morning: thaw Saturday's raw pork and 50 g cooked turkey. Saturday: cook and chill the pork for lunch, and thaw Sunday's 240 g cooked turkey in the refrigerator.
Friday and weekend breakfasts are cooked fresh. Each recipe's ingredient list and method cover only that meal; all cooking ahead, freezing and thawing is kept here.

travelMeals.name: Bacon-cheddar mini egg bites
steps: Heat oven to 350 F. Brush 12 silicone mini-muffin wells with the 6 g butter.
Whisk the 4 eggs with 30 g cream. Fold in 30 g finely chopped cooked bacon and 50 g cheddar. Divide evenly between the 12 wells.
Bake 12-16 min until set and 160 F in the center. Serve 8 bites for Jake and 4 for Laine.

travelMeals.name: Thick turkey, bacon and cauliflower chowder

ingredients.nutritionNote: Small seasoning quantities are excluded from approximate macros.

steps: Cut cauliflower small. Simmer it in the broth with butter and garlic, covered, for 12-15 min until very tender.
Blend the cauliflower mixture with cream and cream cheese until smooth. Return to low heat and stir in cheddar gradually.
Add finely shredded cooked turkey, chopped cooked bacon and 1/2 tsp smoked paprika. Stir gently to 165 F throughout.
Weigh the finished soup; add only enough hot water to bring the batch to 800 g. Keep it thick and spoonable. Serve Jake 500 g and Laine 300 g.

weekendMeals.name: Bacon-cheddar eggs & avocado

ingredients.item: Large eggs - Jake 3 eggs, Laine 2 eggs
Bacon, cooked - Jake 18 g, Laine 20 g
Block cheddar - Jake 25 g, Laine 30 g
Avocado flesh - Jake 40 g, Laine 40 g

steps: Scramble eggs in butter; fold in cheddar. Serve with cooked bacon and fresh avocado.

weekendMeals.name: Warm ranch-chicken lettuce boats

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs, raw - Jake 200 g, Laine 150 g
Block cheddar - Jake 25 g, Laine 30 g
Avocado-oil mayonnaise - Jake 15 g, Laine 20 g
Bacon, cooked - Jake 12 g, Laine 12 g
Dried dill and parsley - 1/4 tsp each
ingredients.nutritionNote: Small seasoning quantities are excluded from approximate macros.

steps: Cook chicken to 165 F, then slice. Mix mayo with dried dill and parsley. Fill romaine with chicken, cheddar and bacon; spoon dressing over. Serve cucumber alongside.

weekendMeals.name: Sausage & Swiss scramble

ingredients.item: Large eggs - Jake 2 eggs, Laine 1 egg
Mild bulk pork sausage, raw - Jake 55 g, Laine 35 g
Swiss cheese - Jake 25 g, Laine 20 g

steps: Brown sausage to 160 F. Add butter and eggs; scramble until set, then melt in Swiss.

weekendMeals.name: Cold pork, cheddar & pecan crunch bowls

ingredients.item: Pork loin, raw - Jake 220 g, Laine 110 g
Block cheddar - Jake 25 g, Laine 15 g
Avocado-oil mayonnaise - Jake 15 g, Laine 12 g
Dijon mustard - Jake 4 g, Laine 3 g

steps: Cook pork to 145 F, rest 3 min, chill and slice. Stir mayo with Dijon. Pack with romaine, cucumber, cheddar and pecans. Serve cold.

weekendMeals.name: Almond-flour waffles with Oikos cream

ingredients.item: Large eggs - Jake 2 eggs, Laine 2 eggs
Almond flour - Jake 25 g, Laine 18 g
4% cottage cheese - Jake 40 g, Laine 35 g
Oikos Triple Zero - Jake 50 g, Laine 40 g
Heavy cream - Jake 15 g, Laine 10 g

steps: Separate eggs. Blend yolks, cottage cheese, flour and melted butter; fold in whipped whites. Cook in a waffle iron until set and golden. Mix Oikos with cream for the topping.

weekendMeals.name: Turkey-Swiss cucumber stacks

ingredients.item: Turkey breast, cooked - Jake 130 g, Laine 65 g
Swiss cheese - Jake 35 g, Laine 25 g
Avocado-oil mayonnaise - Jake 15 g, Laine 12 g
Dijon mustard - Jake 4 g, Laine 3 g

steps: Mix mayo and Dijon. Layer turkey, Swiss and cucumber on dry romaine leaves; serve the measured sauce alongside.

weekendNote: Friday off: three shared meals. Weekend breakfasts/lunches are here; Laine's two weekend mini-meals are in her Hobbit Pantry.

jakeLunch.name: Bacon-ranch chicken thighs, cheddar and sweet pepper

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs, raw - 840 g
Dried dill and parsley - 1 tsp each; black pepper - 1/2 tsp; salt to taste
ingredients.nutritionNote: Small seasoning quantities are excluded from approximate macros.

steps: Season the thighs with salt, pepper, 1 tsp dried dill and 1 tsp dried parsley. Brown in butter in batches.
Soften the diced pepper in the pan. Add broth, cream and cream cheese; stir smooth. Return chicken and simmer to at least 165 F.
Fold in cheddar and cooked bacon. Divide the cooked chicken evenly between 3 containers, then divide every bit of sauce evenly.
jakeLunch.macrosNote: Nutrition per container; ingredient amounts make 3 containers.
jakeLunch.note: Three containers for Mon-Wed. Reheating and travel packing are in the opening prep schedule.
